automatic_rule: Continuous metrics use linear clipped quality anchors; hard gates apply independently. Master/repair are measured losslessly; preview is only checked for reconstruction and viewing.

hard_constraints.format: master and repair:FFV1 MKV,624frames,24fps,640x338,RGB8(no subsampling),no audio; preview:MP4,H264,624frames,24fps,640x338,no audio
hard_constraints.protected: [0,48),[264,288),[600,624) are normal reference windows; per-frame mean absolute RGB error to input<=0.006; repair neutral is encouraged, no forced changes
hard_constraints.restoration: at least1.0dB PSNR improvement over damaged input in EACH degraded assessment block [48,144),[144,264),[288,432),[432,600); no averaging easy windows to hide an unprocessed block
hard_constraints.motion_detail: on truth-defined moving regions mean RGB error<=0.060; true-edge Sobel magnitude relative absolute error<=0.70 and magnitude ratio between0.55 and1.55; pixel-space frame alignment remains1:1
hard_constraints.temporal: truth-flow-compensated grayscale residual error<=0.035 on valid correspondences; no>=6 consecutive frames frozen while truth has measurable movement
hard_constraints.lighting: authored warm moving sweep and slow cool darkening must remain, no new flicker; each intentional event gain0.70–1.30 relative to clean-minus-base light field, tile linear-RGB MAE<=0.025; event timing/appearance additionally judged
hard_constraints.repair_replay: repair represents signed delta2*(channel-128). Reconstruction=clip(round_even(input+delta*strength),0,255),strength1.0. Max absolute difference from submitted master<=1 integer level per RGB sample, all624frames. Neutral128. Full image correction range covered with1level quantization tolerance.
hard_constraints.preview_replay: each frame RGB MAE to master<=0.025 and grayscale correlation>=0.97; no overlays or different restored content
hard_constraints.frame_map: exact0..623; no crop/mirror/reorder/invented actions or missing frames
hard_constraints.editing_intervention: replay strength0 returns original input; strength0.5 must yield the arithmetic midpoint to within1 integer level; actual changed-pixel count reported. This verifies editable correction delivery, NOT restoration-algorithm reproducibility.

metric_definitions.restoration: mean per-assessment-block PSNR gain; target includes authored light changes, not rawEXR
metric_definitions.motion_detail: 50% motionRGBquality +50% truth-edge relative-gradient-error quality; moving mask comes from clean base frame changes, not candidate
metric_definitions.gradient: Sobel magnitude divided by4 on grayscale; truth edges magnitude>0.08; compare candidates on same fixed mask
metric_definitions.temporal: compare candidate-vs-truth warp residual at320x169 with fixed truth backwardFarneback and trusted validity mask
metric_definitions.lighting: linearize displayRGB with fixed sRGB transfer for tile metric; intended gain estimated by projection onto target-minus-base field across each event; no posthoc color fitting
metric_definitions.protected: all normal frames separately, includes middle and end rather than just initial prefix

judge_items.criterion: 相对真实目标，手指、握持、松手、器件关系和镜头运动均保留，无新增/丢失动作、冻结或合成假细节；有真实运动模糊时不误判为缺陷。

rating_anchors.0: 动作/物件关系变化或明显冻结、伪造。
rating_anchors.0.5: 主要动作正确，局部手部边缘/纹理有修复瑕疵。
rating_anchors.1: 动作、轮廓、接触/松开与细节均可信且连续。

judge_items.criterion: 实际降低暗部/色度噪声与运动后拖影，未用整幅模糊、蜡化、过锐和游动纹理换取数值；看全长与运动/细节窗口。

rating_anchors.0: 未改善或以严重模糊/拖尾/伪纹理替代原损伤。
rating_anchors.0.5: 明显改善但仍有少量残噪、细边软化或短暂残影。
rating_anchors.1: 噪声和拖影受控，纹理自然，未见影响复用的修复伪影。

judge_items.criterion: 保留移动暖扫光和缓慢冷暗变化的空间形状、节奏与颜色，去除额外高频闪动；正常保护窗与修复段之间自然衔接。

rating_anchors.0: 光变被抹除/错位、颜色意图反转或新明显闪烁。
rating_anchors.0.5: 两种意图保持，但局部亮度/色彩或接缝尚需修整。
rating_anchors.1: 意图光变完整自然，时点与形态一致，无新增异常闪动。

coefficient.delivery: normalized verified delivery checks, clipped to [0,1]
coefficient.repair_replay: normalized verified repair replay checks, clipped to [0,1]
coefficient.missing_or_unverified: formal total remains pending; do not assume C=1
coefficient.hard_failures: Existing hard/critical failures independently prevent acceptance.

final_formula: S=C*(sum(automatic_quality_points)+sum(visual_quality_points)); automatic 40, visual 60; round only final total to 4 decimals
weighting_scope: Final reporting weights applied to frozen measurements and verified judge ratings; solver task and output unchanged.
